title: Variant table
description: data/variants/<base>.json: the parts npm run generate-variants makes from a base part — one per combination of the options in groups (e.g. every size × finish × tier), each drawn with the base part's model

base.description: The part the variants are of (their model, and every field the options don't change)

id.description: Each variant's id: {group} is its option's key there, {base} the base part's id — e.g. {base}_{size}_{finish}. Ids never change once made: a variant no longer in the table is retired, not deleted

name.description: Each variant's name: {group} is its option's name

base.description: The price the options' priceFactors multiply: a number, or "part" for the base part's price

round.description: Rounded to a multiple of this

skip.description: Combinations not to make: each {group: key, …} matches every combination with those options

name.description: In the variant's name (default: the key)

look.description: Merged into the variant's look (finish, colour, materials)

scale.description: The model drawn this much bigger (look.scale)

set.description: Fields set on the variant, by path: { "rim.diameter": 17, "provides": ["rim:17"], "tier": "sport" }
